description: Ministry of Justice and Labour Relations - Order to declare that the Provisions of Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act No. 25 of 2002 shall apply in respect of the Agreement between the Governments of Sri Lanka and the United Arab Emirates
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the declaration of a legal agreement (Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act) between Sri Lanka and the United Arab Emirates. It involves the application of legal provisions, mutual legal assistance in criminal matters, and the rescinding of a previous order. The content focuses on legal/regulatory framework and international agreements rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any other specialized category.
